faqs.q: Can I complete my implant treatment in one trip?
faqs.a: Many cases, including All-on-4 and All-on-6, can be completed within a single 5-7 day visit. More complex cases involving grafting may need a short second trip for final restorations.

faqs.q: How long do dental implants last?
faqs.a: With proper care and regular check-ups, implants can last 15-20 years or longer. The surrounding restoration may need replacement over time, but the implant itself is designed to be a long-term solution.

faqs.q: Can I eat normally after full mouth implant treatment?
faqs.a: Yes. Once healing is complete and your final restoration is fitted, you can eat a normal diet. We provide a short-term soft food guide immediately after surgery to protect healing tissue.

faqs.q: What is the difference between All-on-4 and All-on-6?
faqs.a: Both replace a full arch of teeth with a fixed bridge. All-on-6 uses six implants instead of four, offering additional support that can suit patients with lower bone density or higher bite force.

faqs.q: How much can I save on full-mouth implants in Vietnam?
faqs.a: International patients typically save 50-70% compared to costs in the US, UK, Australia or New Zealand, without compromising on materials or technique. We provide a fixed quote after your consultation.
